WinPE-runnable binary embedded into boot images by Media Builder, either via the
"Automatic download" source option (always resolves the `mse-ci-client-latest` alias
release) or by pointing Media Builder at a local extracted copy of one of these ZIPs
matching its selected target architecture.

### Setup profiles

- **Prepare setup step**: after the image is applied and before boot is configured, the Client
  writes the device's setup profile registry values, runs its Offline scripts, stages its
  Specialize scripts and writes the answer file. Results are reported on the deployment timeline.
  The step is skipped on devices without a profile.
- **Profile fetched first**: the pinned profile version, the scripts for the device's location and
  the answer file are downloaded and verified before the disk is formatted, so a device that cannot
  get its profile stops before anything is erased. Only the scripts for the device's location run.
- **Scripts never held in memory**: after the image is applied, the scripts are downloaded again
  straight to the installed Windows volume and checked again, so a profile with many large scripts
  does not fill the boot image's memory. They are deleted when Prepare setup ends.
- **Setup runner**: Specialize scripts run in the specialize pass before OOBE, with their timeouts
  and without the right to restart the device. Results are logged to
  `C:\Windows\Logs\CloudImaging\SetupRunner.log`.
- Needs backend `mse-ci-v1.1.0` and a boot image from Media Builder `mse-ci-mediabuilder-v1.1.0`,
  which adds PowerShell to WinPE.

### Signed boot image update checks

- **Signed check**: the boot media update check is signed with the boot media private key, and
  each signature can be used once, so only genuine boot media gets a boot image download link.
- **Regenerate boot images**: media built with an earlier Client sends an unsigned check, which
  backend `mse-ci-v1.1.0` no longer answers, so that media stops updating itself. Generate new boot
  images with this Client and prepare the USB media again. Follow
  [Regenerate boot images for signed update checks](https://github.com/MSEndpointMgr/CloudImaging/blob/main/docs/upgrade-instructions.md#regenerate-boot-images-for-signed-update-checks).
- Needs backend `mse-ci-v1.1.0`: an earlier backend cannot answer the signed check.

### Wi-Fi across a certificate rotation

- When the media has just updated itself to a newer boot image, the Client fetches the Wi-Fi
  networks again before asking for the restart. During a certificate rotation overlap the file it
  stores is readable by both certificates, so the new boot image still joins Wi-Fi.
- Needs backend `mse-ci-v1.1.0`.
